mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by at least 0.4 percentage points over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of elevated industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), a decline in the industrial production index signals an impending supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.5% within the past month signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) over the past quarter signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 1% over the prior quarter, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals the onset of a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0% and rises by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that increases recession risk and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
